name: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Ltd
title: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Ltd - 544921 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 recovery-led quarter: recoveries up 151% to INR1,066 crores, but acquisitions fell to INR353 crores and standalone PAT of INR143 crores was flattered by INR120 crores of write-backs; no numeric guidance given.

triggers.label: Acquisitions INR353 crores, down ~INR150 crores YoY
triggers.quote: We acquired INR353 crores of stressed assets, with Arcil investing INR143 crores of its own capital.
triggers.highlight: We acquired INR353 crores of stressed assets

triggers.label: Write-backs INR120 crores flatter Q1
triggers.quote: Recovery of security receipts, fee and expenses written off in earlier years, contributed INR120 crores.

triggers.label: Acquisition cost ~26% of dues
triggers.quote: we have acquired assets at about 26% of their outstanding dues
triggers.highlight: acquired assets at about 26% of their outstanding dues

triggers.label: Recoveries up 151% to INR1,066 crores
triggers.quote: Total recoveries were INR1,066 crores against INR425 crores in Q1 FY26, an increase of 151%.

guidance.value: no numeric guidance; 'we are not giving any guidance on these numbers'

red_flags.label: Write-backs drive Q1 profit
red_flags.quote: We would not have very large sums going forward because write-offs from the system have gone away.

red_flags.label: Consolidated PAT far below standalone
red_flags.quote: Consolidated profit after tax for the quarter was INR59 crores, against standalone profit of INR143 crores.

red_flags.label: Opaque IRR and vintage disclosure
red_flags.quote: our general IRR across the businesses historically is on the higher 20s

evasions.quote: at this moment, we're not giving guidance on actual numbers.
We are not giving any guidance on these numbers.
I think it's too early for us to comment on this.
